Name: Stardew Valley Futures - AI Crop Trading
Author: ruralalan
Description:
RStardew Futures — AI-Powered Crop Futures Trading

Turn Pelican Town into a living crop futures market.

Trade Pumpkin, Cauliflower, Melon, Starfruit, and Ancient Fruit futures with leverage. Watch prices move, open long or short positions, manage margin risk, and use your real harvested crops for physical settlement.

But this is not just a trading panel.

Six AI-powered NPC traders run their own portfolios, gossip about the market, remember your actions, and react to both in-game events and real-world news reshaped into Stardew-style market events. A real headline can become tomorrow's crop rumor. A global food story can turn into a Pelican Town price shock. A suspicious news item can become the spark for a market raid.

Every day feels like a small market drama.


Core fantasy

What if Stardew Valley had a living futures exchange?

- Pierre tries to trade like a value investor.
- Morris spreads insider-style gossip.
- Emily trusts intuition and strange signs.
- Harvey manages risk carefully.
- Shane gambles too hard.
- Tanaka Taro, the Joja CEO, enters as a hostile market boss.

They do not just wait for you.

They trade.
They talk.
They remember.
They sometimes lie.
They react to news.
And they can move against you.


Features

- Crop futures exchange — trade 5 crop contracts: Pumpkin, Cauliflower, Melon, Starfruit, and Ancient Fruit.
- Leverage system — choose 1x, 3x, or 5x leverage, with margin, liquidation risk, profit, loss, and settlement.
- Long and short positions — profit from both rising and falling crop prices.
- Physical settlement — use real harvested crops from your farm to settle futures positions.
- 6 AI NPC traders — each NPC has personality, memory, trading style, risk preference, and market opinion.
- Real-world news integration — selected real headlines are reshaped into in-game market events, rumors, and price narratives.
- Market gossip system — NPCs share rumors and insider-style tips. Some are true, some are misleading.
- NPC memory — NPCs remember your behavior, trading habits, past interactions, and whether you helped or hurt them.
- Group chat — NPCs discuss the market together, argue, react, and sometimes reveal useful information.
- Private NPC chat — press F7 near an NPC to talk directly and try to get market information.
- News tab — read market news, daily flavor events, and real-world inspired headlines.
- Achievements and leaderboard — track your trading career and performance.
- Rule-based fallback — fully playable without any AI key.
- 11 languages — includes English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, and Turkish.


Real-world news as market fuel

Stardew Futures can pull real-world news signals and convert them into Stardew-style market stories.

For example:

- A real food supply headline may become a crop shortage rumor.
- A commodity story may become a price shock in Pelican Town.
- A trending topic may be rewritten as a local market narrative.
- NPCs may react to these events with their own opinions and trades.

The goal is not to copy real life directly.

The goal is to make the Stardew market feel alive — like the outside world is leaking into Pelican Town through rumors, headlines, and speculation.


Three ways to play

- Rule-based mode — no AI key required. NPCs use deterministic trading rules. Fully playable and free.
- Free trial mode — use a trial license key provided by the author. Good for players who want to try the AI features without setting up an API key.
- Bring your own API key — supports OpenAI-compatible providers such as DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, Doubao, and Ollama.

You can enjoy the core futures system without AI.

AI makes the world more reactive, social, and unpredictable.


How to install

1. Install SMAPI 4.0.0+ from https://smapi.io
2. Download the Stardew Futures zip file.
3. Extract the zip.
4. Put the StardewFutures folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
6. Press F8 in-game to open the futures panel.

Correct folder structure:

Stardew Valley/Mods/StardewFutures/manifest.json
Stardew Valley/Mods/StardewFutures/StardewFutures.dll
Stardew Valley/Mods/StardewFutures/assets/
Stardew Valley/Mods/StardewFutures/i18n/

If SMAPI cannot detect the mod, check that you did not accidentally create a double folder like:

Stardew Valley/Mods/StardewFutures/StardewFutures/manifest.json


Controls

- F8 — open or close the futures trading panel.
- F7 — talk to a nearby NPC.
- SMAPI console command — use sf help for available commands.


Tabs inside the panel

- Market — view crop futures prices and market movement.
- Positions — check your open positions, profit, loss, and margin.
- Trade — open long or short positions.
- News — read market news and real-world inspired events.
- Chat — watch NPCs discuss the market.
- NPC Holdings — see what other traders are holding.
- Achievements — track milestones.
- Leaderboard — compare trading performance.
- Settings — configure AI provider, trial mode, or rule-based mode.


Compatibility

- Stardew Valley 1.6.x
- SMAPI 4.0.0+
- Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Single-player focused
- Generic Mod Config Menu is optional

This mod uses its own futures economy and does not directly replace Stardew Valley's normal crop sell prices.

It should be compatible with most gameplay mods, but may conflict with mods that heavily rewrite crop economy or pricing systems.


AI and privacy

No API key is included in this mod package.

If you choose an AI provider, you enter your own API key in the Settings tab. That key is stored locally in your own mod config file.

If you use trial mode, the mod contacts the trial server to activate your license and relay AI requests. The trial system is designed for convenience, not as a requirement. You can always play in rule-based mode without any AI provider.


Known limitations

- Multiplayer is not the main target for v1.0.
- Some AI features depend on provider availability and network connection.
- Real-world news features may vary depending on network access.
- AI responses can sometimes be imperfect, but trading decisions are constrained by the futures system.


Recommended for players who like

- Stardew Valley economy mods
- Trading and market simulation
- AI NPC interaction
- Emergent stories
- Risk management and speculation
- Watching small systems create drama


Not recommended if

- You only want a vanilla farming experience.
- You dislike numbers, trading, or market risk.
- You expect AI NPCs to be perfectly predictable.


Credits

- Built for Stardew Valley using SMAPI.
- Inspired by market games, social simulation, AI NPC experiments, and Stardew Valley's cozy economy.
